notes.title: Project Werewulf: Development Roadmap (2025-2026)
notes.notes:
[p]Ladies and Gentlemen,  

We’re thrilled to share the exciting updates and content planned for Project Werewulf through 2025 and into 2026!   Here’s what you can expect in the coming months, along with an invitation to share your feedback to help shape the game’s future.  

[b]October 2025:[/b] 

[u]Halloween Event & New Challenge Level[/u]

[b]Halloween Event:[/b]

Spooky collectibles and exclusive outfits to celebrate the season. Limited-time event activities with unique rewards. 

[b]New Challenge Level:[/b]   

"Sabotage: Kidnap Scenario": Jess must escape the clutches of the Special Forces using her strength, seductive skills, or clever puzzle-solving. We’re aiming to release this level alongside the Halloween event, packed with thrilling gameplay and intense moments.   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43764480/9bbeb2f1b6f12835e165ad81d9da28bce078126c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43764480/c5e4d8e339667f9bfeedb05d277af7eade0170da.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43764480/03fbd4718ba06b8b1789a304dcac30ac1b61d1de.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43764480/5645d0f28c3c23851250f49430884ea5ce84a35e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43764480/0446b40e82567477b3016aaf36a10bdc2476c189.png"][/img][b]December 2025:[/b] 

[b]Christmas Event:[/b]    

Festive outfits and holiday-themed activities to spread cheer across the space station. Special event rewards and surprises to close out the year.     

[b]Early 2026:[/b]     

[b]Major Story Mission:[/b]

A fully voiced, five-level questline featuring cinematic cutscenes, new characters, a formidable boss, and unexpected twists. We’re taking our time to ensure this content meets the highest quality standards, so it may slip into next year for maximum polish. 

[b]2026: Expanding the Universe

New Storylines with Playable Characters:[/b]

Explore compact, engaging story arcs featuring additional playable characters. Play as Hannah after Jess’s daring rescue. Dive into Miho’s unique quests. Experience the perspective of a nameless survivor navigating the dangers of the space station. 

Which character’s story are you most excited to explore? Let us know! 

[b]Ongoing Updates[/b]

[b]Community-Driven Features:

[/b]We’re committed to implementing your feedback with regular quality-of-life (QOL) updates, new interactions in safe areas, and other community-requested features. Your input is invaluable—keep sharing your ideas to help us make Project Werewulf even better! 

Thank you for your continued support and for joining us on this thrilling journey! 

Stay tuned for more updates, and we can’t wait to see you in-game!

Best regards, 

FTR Team[/p]

notes.title: Rumors are not facts
notes.notes:
[p]Ladies and Gentlemen,

I'm sure you've all heard the rumors that Steam doesn't allow NSFW games to release free updates, only paid DLCs. 

[b]This is simply not true.[/b] 

Since our game's release, we've rolled out numerous free updates, with the latest major content update dropping just [b]three days ago.[/b] 

Steam hasn't officially changed its policies, and there's no rule in the Terms of Service supporting this claim. 

These rumors stem from a handful of vague NSFW game developer announcements with no solid backing. 

[b]We will continue to release free updates in the future.[/b] 

Have a great day![/p]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
A few player have reported that after opening and closing the menu causing FPS drops.

We have investigated the issue, and it turned out that due to the changes of the engine, applying some of the graphic settings causing temporary performance issues especially on weaker hardwares.

We have changed some codes in the menu, and implemented a warning if you are changing and applying the settings which requires a game restart.

You can still apply the settings without restarting the game, however a restart is recommended if you experiencing performance issues after changing the settings.

Thank you, and have a great weekend!

notes.title: 2025 Road map and info
notes.notes:
[p]Ladies and Gentlemen,

In the last month we studied UE 5.6, and Epic has made a lot of amazing features and changes, which opens new methods and possibilities in the case of the further development. 

Also we were able to improve our pipelines and workflow in the new engine version. Therefore we have decided [b]to update Project Werewulf to Unreal Engine 5.6[/b], which we have made already, and soon it will be ready for internal testing. 

What is this means? 

In the upcoming update - beside of the many quality changes/improvements and community requested features - you will notice around 20-30% better performance. 

What is this means for the future of Project Werewulf? 

Because we were able to update the game, this means we can improve the existing mechanics, and we can implement new features in the upcoming contents.

notes.title: Development update - Gameplay time
notes.notes:
Now that we have the complete structure of the game, lets talk about the actual gameplay time of [b]Project Werewulf
[/b]
There gonna be six prominent levels. Each of these prominent levels contains cinematic cutscenes.

To reach these prominent levels you have to complete - lets name them - standard levels.
These "standard levels" will have a variety of gameplay, like gunfight, traversal, stealth, puzzle, and of course some of them you gonna play as a werewolf.

There will be like minimum four "standard levels" to reach one of the prominent level, which means there gonna be minimum 21 "standard levels" plus the prominent levels.

The cutscenes gonna cover the main story, but lots of information you can get from note pads, which you can find around the levels.

Beside the story levels, lets talk about the free time activities:

-Around at 30% of the playthrough you gonna reach the HUB.

-Around at 50% of the playthrough you gonna reach the HQ with all the side levels:
 
Apartment ( with guests )
Laboratory ( with lycan captives )
Club ( dancing / drinking / private show )
Gym and gaming room ( surprise )

Every time when you complete a prominent level, you will go back the the HUB/HQ, and you can spend your time there as long as you want.

Repeatable quests:

-HUB defense: 
Lycans attacking the HUB, you have to deal with them in waves.

-Combat zone:
You can reach the combat zone ( 5 random levels ) which you have to clear. On these levels you will get random loot. ( Outfits )

From these levels you can be kidnapped to the Lycans Hideout.


So according to the current statistics - depends on your play style - to complete the story you will need minimum 15 -20 hours.

[b]Beside that you gonna have plenty of free time activities and interactions in the safe areas.[/b]

We are gonna implement achievements too.

Also we are developing the game in the way we can always add plus content later - [b]new combat levels, more outfits, more interactions, even more story missions, and of course with community requested content[/b] -, and im planning to support Project Werewulf after the release.

[b]Thank you for following the development![/b] 

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Temporary solution for the rare "black screen on startup" bug.
notes.notes:
A few player has reported that they stuck in black screen on startup. 

The problem is a D3D issue what can cause the new ( 5.3 ) version of UE, or even the 2022 version of visual studio. On every start Unreal generates/overwrite a file, and sometimes it cause an issue.

If you encounter with this problem, please got to:

C:// user/appdata/local/project werewulf/saved

And delete the "Project_Werewulf_PCD3D_SM6" file.

Then restart the demo.

We are aware to fix the issue.

Thank you for your understanding!

FTR
